prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving interface–outbound-load release; no explicit modes. Elements/aliases: Inbound Inspection Desk=Cinderbay; Pallet Dimension Scanner=Moonquarry; Inbound Pallet Buffer; North Aisle Stacker Crane=Juniperwake; South Aisle Stacker Crane; East Transfer Conveyor; West Transfer Conveyor; Conveyor Line Controller=Brasshaven; Autonomous Forklift Fleet=Larkspur; Yard Gate Controller=Velvetrook; Outbound Dispatch Sorter; Outbound Checkweigh Scale; Shipping Documentation Desk; Warehouse Operations Supervisor; Warehouse Management System=Morrowglass; Safety Zone Controller; Fire Alarm Panel; Maintenance Release Terminal. Items: Cinderbay produces inspection/damage/identifier/seal records, sends Trailer Seal Exception Note. Moonquarry measures dimensions/profiles; produces Oversize Load Advisory (exceeded limits, not placement authorization); measurements support oversized-load routing/handling. Morrowglass produces Slot Reservation Receipt (position/suitability), sends Dispatch Wave Amendment for destination/priority/sequence changes after preparation begins. Sorter receives/applies authorized amendments; preserves committed order unless explicitly changed. Brasshaven produces Transfer Induction Ticket with identifiers/routing; validates fields, holds duplicates. Juniperwake sends/updates Aisle Occupancy Snapshot. Larkspur produces Forklift Handoff Confirmation after completed transfer: vehicle/pallet identifiers, time, receiving position, incomplete/deferred movements. Fire Alarm Panel produces Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice upon applicable fire-protection condition. Scale provides weights; documentation desk prepares shipment records from confirmed pallet/destination data. Requirements: validate arrival/receiving plan, windows, unscheduled entry, identification/seals/counts; segregate damage; coordinate doors/staging/crews; pause unsafe unloading; record inspection/counts/door release before closure/allocation. Allocation requires suitability, capacity, clearance, restrictions, reservation/access availability. Enforce aisle zoning and cross-aisle authorization. Conveyor interlocks require valid routing, occupancy/presence, downstream readiness; hold blocked/stale paths; space accumulation; single-pallet merges. Fleet validates vehicle/area/path, selects tasks by priority/battery/proximity, considers access/transfer readiness/pedestrian restrictions, confirms pickup identity/location, limits speed/turning, stops/reroutes under safety controls. Verify staging against plan before loading. Supervisor reviews delays/stops/constraints before next-wave release. Morrowglass authoritatively maintains inventory/location/eligibility/task state/priorities. Timely updates prevent duplicate assignments;

New part:
S128: Yard Gate Controller records unresolved discrepancies for review and prevents an affected vehicle from proceeding when the discrepancy creates an operating risk.
S129: Yard Gate Controller uses the exception note to manage a receiving discrepancy at the gate.
S130: The receiving exception remains visible to the Warehouse Operations Supervisor until the discrepancy has been assessed and resolved.
S131: Inbound Inspection Desk records inspection outcomes before pallets enter routine warehouse handling.
S132: Inbound Pallet Buffer provides a controlled staging point when inspection or downstream handling is not yet ready.
S133: Pallet Dimension Scanner supplies measurements used to identify pallets that require a different handling path.
S134: Conveyor Line Controller coordinates conveyor movement and stops affected equipment when a downstream condition prevents safe transfer.
S135: East Transfer Conveyor and West Transfer Conveyor provide separate routes for moving pallets between operating areas.
S136: Autonomous Forklift Fleet receives work only when a route and destination are available for the assigned vehicle.
S137: North Aisle Stacker Crane and South Aisle Stacker Crane report operating availability so task allocation can account for equipment status.
S138: The Warehouse Operations Supervisor can defer work when a route conflict, equipment fault, or staging constraint remains unresolved.
S139: Maintenance Release Terminal is also known as Copperfield.
S140: Maintenance Release Terminal produces the Crane Service Release Card after required maintenance checks have been completed.
S141: Maintenance authorization is recorded before affected equipment is returned to operational service.
S142: Morrowglass reconciles work across operating areas and preserves a consistent view of task status and outstanding constraints.
S143: Outbound Dispatch Sorter organizes completed pallets according to the current shipping plan.
S144: Outbound Checkweigh Scale verifies shipment weight before the shipping record is finalized.
S145: Shipping Documentation Desk prepares shipment records from confirmed pallet and destination data.
S146: Fire Alarm Panel and Safety Zone Controller provide safety status that can require movement to stop or be restricted.
S147: Warehouse Operations Supervisor reviews delayed tasks, abnormal vehicle stops, and unresolved staging constraints before releasing the next outbound wave.
S148: Exception handling preserves a traceable hold state until the source of a discrepancy is understood and the affected pallet can be safely routed.
S149: A mismatch between expected and observed pallet attributes prevents automatic allocation and directs the load to controlled review.
S150: The operating record retains the scan result, location, and time of detection so that the review can be reconstructed.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
